verdict.rationale: Rippling's docs say approved hours from Time & Attendance flow instantly into Payroll, timesheets can be reviewed inside each pay run, and hours sync with payroll. Overtime rules are applied automatically by location, and punch errors are flagged before payroll runs. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that calculated overtime pay lands as payroll earnings (it is only implied by the overtime policies), in-depth docs beyond marketing pages, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
